evals.name: large-github-pr
evals.prompt: Look at this PR: https://github.com/LabOS-co/printer-service/pull/4 - I need to 100% understand what was done here, I'll be maintaining it.
evals.expected_output: A published change map with Map, Walkthrough, Simulator, Files and Commits tabs; every claim grounded in real code; a narrated walkthrough whose line marker follows the voice.

assertions.text: Every file → symbol reference resolves in the repo (build reports 0 unresolved)
files.json matches the PR (91 files, +14110/-332) and the excerpts come from diff_base..sha
The walkthrough explains at least 80% of the changed code files
Every beat anchor occurs in the excerpt shown (no 'not in the excerpt shown' warning)
narrate.py lint reports no spoken IDs, paths or hashes
Every narration line has a recorded clip in the chosen voice
Real-clock browser playback plays clips to the end and advances on its own

evals.name: script-smoke
evals.expected_output: PASS with all checks: prepare, build, ref resolution, coverage count, auto-placement, beat anchors, story merge, problem order, real-diff excerpts, diff range, simulator links.

evals.name: perforce-cl
evals.prompt: Explain shelved CL 123456 to me, I need to own it.
evals.expected_output: prepare.py --p4 builds files.json/meta.json from p4 describe; excerpts come from the workspace files.

assertions.text: prepare.py --p4 <CL> --shelved writes files.json with the CL's files and statuses

evals.name: stakeholder-brief
evals.prompt: Look at this PR: https://github.com/LabOS-co/printer-service/pull/4 - I need to present it to the stakeholders for the release and the risk review.
evals.expected_output: The change map gains a Brief tab first in the tab bar (the page still opens on Map, #brief opens it): a step-by-step stakeholder deck with business value, before/after, the system, 1-3 major use-case flows, one risk and release slide and takeaways, speaker notes on every slide and step, and a Present mode.

assertions.text: deck.json builds with exit 0, prints 'deck: N slides (F flows), S reveal steps; 0 lint' and every mitigation ref resolves
title, value, before_after, system, 1-3 flow slides tied to real scenario ids, risk, takeaways, in that order
every slide and every reveal step carries a speaker note
no shown text reads as code (jargon lint 0) and every title stat has a source
Brief is the first tab, the page opens on Map, #brief opens the deck, Next/Back/keys reveal steps and Present fits the screen
without deck.json the embedded data, build stdout and lint.txt are identical to the pre-change engine on real past work folders
